Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Acme Data + Redwood — Marketplace listing & evaluation

Hi Helen and team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a mutual action plan (MAP) to align timelines, owners, and the marketplace listing path (AWS + Azure). The primary goals are:

- Complete technical evaluation (functional + performance)
- Finish procurement and procurement redlines
- Complete marketplace listing approvals so Acme can purchase via partner listing if desired

I attached a first-pass MAP (Acme-MAP-v1.0.pdf) that proposes the following high-level timeline:
- Technical evaluation window: May 18 — May 29
- Procurement & legal approvals: target complete by June 10
- Marketplace listing live (soft launch): target July 1

Asks / immediate next steps:
1) Please confirm you’re good with the proposed evaluation window, and share the internal owners for Security, Procurement, and Cloud Ops.
2) Maya and Tom — can you confirm marketplace ops contacts and the approximate lead time for review/approval for AWS and Azure respectively?
3) Dev — can your team run a 90-minute technical workshop the week of May 18 to validate performance at our standard load (we’ll bring a checklist).
4) I’ll schedule a short weekly sync (30m) starting May 19 to track blockers.

Attachments: [Attachment: Acme-MAP-v1.0.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
